_doc: 4-man Gravewyrm Sanctum FARM. pala1/Pontius (paladin, the TANK + leader -- Protection: Righteous Fury aura + Consecration spam for threat, Seal/Judgement) + ryze3/ryzeheal (priest, the HEALER -- Renew + Lesser Heal; pure heals, healerDps OFF, shieldTank OFF -- shield is inefficient right now) + sham2/Shims (shaman ENHANCEMENT, melee DPS -- Stormstrike + Earth Shock) + ryze/swifter (hunter, ranged DPS + designated puller; its pet off-tanks loose adds) + ryzemage (mage, an OPERATOR-CONTROLLED GUEST -- combat.guests, NOT a bot: the leader invites it at the door and the muster HOLDS until it joins, so it is in the group BEFORE they zone in; the operator drives its Frostbolt + Conjure Water. It is the water source + a 4th DPS so Korzul dies before the paladin OOMs). NO warrior. The paladin is auto-picked as tank (first melee; shaman is in the orchestrator MELEE set so it closes for Stormstrike). They march to the Sanctum door (0,880), the hunter ranged-pulls one mob at a time, the paladin grabs threat (no taunt -> Consecration/Seal), single-pull chamber-by-chamber to the three bosses looting every corpse, then after KORZUL dies + loot is grabbed they RESET the instance (leave + reform = fresh instance) and farm again. The PALADIN (tank/leader) need-rolls everything; the other three greed. Run via scripts/_farm_supervisor.sh (CFG points here), or: node scripts/multibox.mjs scripts/multibox.gravewyrm4.json
